overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures dehydrated onion powder for bulk food manufacturing, seasoning systems, and private label programs. The product is processed from selected onions under controlled cleaning, drying, grinding, and sieving steps. It is offered as a fine milled ingredient with consistent particle size, stable handling, and supply support for domestic and export requirements.

The powder is available from India in standard commercial grades suited for food processors, distributors, restaurants, and ingredient brands. Buyers can request OEM supply, private label packing, custom mesh, and packaging formats based on their application needs. TradeNest Naturals also supports samples on request, export documentation, and bulk dispatch through a structured six-step process.

faqs.q: What is the product form of this onion powder?
faqs.a: It is a fine milled dehydrated onion powder made from selected onions and processed through cleaning, controlled drying, grinding, sieving, inspection, and packing.

faqs.q: What mesh size do you supply?
faqs.a: The standard supply is 80-100 mesh. Custom mesh size can be arranged on request.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.a: The MOQ starts at 5 Kg, with bulk supply available for larger orders.

faqs.q: Do you offer OEM and private label supply?
faqs.a: Yes. OEM manufacturing and private label packing are available, including small branded pouches and jars on request.
Packaging can include 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5-10 kg bags, and small private-label pouches and jars.

faqs.q: Do you support export orders and documents?
faqs.a: Yes. We are an IEC-registered exporter and provide export documentation support along with samples on request.
